name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A modal window on the #171717 overlay surface over a Black scrim: a Funnel Display title, a line under it, a ghost close button, a short form or an offer, and buttons at the foot.
use_for: A short task that needs the whole attention for a moment: naming a new board, an offer, a setting with a few fields. Escape, the close button and the scrim close it.
never: A long flow or a whole page in a window
Two primary buttons in the foot
A shadow or a glow around the window
source: Derived from the guidelines: the #171717 card fill on Black, neutral hairlines, the 10px canvas corner (8px here), Funnel Display titles, DM Sans text, the White primary button; the offer copy from the plan card. shadcn's dialog for anatomy, focus and keys.

examples.name: NewBoard
examples.label: A short form
examples.content:
'use client' import { useState } from 'react' import { Button } from '@/react/components/ui/Button' import { Dialog } from '@/react/components/ui/Dialog' import { Input } from '@/react/components/ui/Input' // A new board in a short form: the button opens it on the Name field, Enter creates it, Escape or the scrim closes it. export default function NewBoard() { const [open, setOpen] = useState(false) const [note, setNote] = useState('Boards keep the creatives you save.') return (

{note}

{ e.preventDefault() const name = new FormData(e.currentTarget).get('name') || 'Untitled board' setNote(`Created ${name}.`) setOpen(false) }} >
) }
